title: Autocatalytic Cores in Reaction Networks with Explicit Catalysis
summary: Autocatalytic cores are minimal units in reaction networks (RNs) responsible for the emergence of autocatalysis. In the absence of explicit catalysis, i.e., when an entity appears both as reactant and product in the same reaction, they are known to be encoded by square submatrices of the stoichiometric matrix whose columns can be reordered as an irreducible child-selection (CS) matrix with negative diagonal and nonnegative off-diagonal (Metzler matrix).
